mssql.description: SQL Server connection for MOS database investigations (optional - only needed for advanced Mossy investigations)
mssql.disabledReason: Enable this only if you need Mossy to perform database investigations. Basic email processing does not require SQL Server access.

readme.title: MCP Server Configuration for Email Processing Skill
readme.description: This configuration file is OPTIONAL. The basic email processing skill works without MCP servers. Only enable MCP servers if you need advanced database investigation capabilities.

mcpServerInfo.whatIsMCP: Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers extend agent capabilities by providing access to external systems like databases, APIs, and tools.
whenToEnable: You need Mossy to investigate database issues
You want root cause analysis with SQL queries
You need SSIS execution log analysis
You want vendor price comparison across systems
whenNotNeeded: Basic email to ADO work item processing

installation.step1: Locate your VS Code settings.json file
installation.step2: Add the mcpServers section from this file to your settings.json
installation.step3: Change 'disabled: true' to 'disabled: false' for servers you want to enable
installation.step4: Update connection strings to match your environment
installation.step5: Restart VS Code to load MCP servers

mssql_server.description: SQL Server MCP server for database investigations
required_for: Pricing issue investigations (check vendor prices in databases)
Data normalization (Solvas vs MOS Portal comparison)

customization.change_server: Update MSSQL_SERVER to your SQL Server instance
customization.change_database: Update MSSQL_DATABASE to default database (usually Core)
customization.change_auth: Set MSSQL_TRUSTED_CONNECTION=false and add MSSQL_USER/MSSQL_PASSWORD for SQL auth

security.credential_storage: Never store passwords in this file for distribution
security.use_sql_auth: If SQL auth required: Use environment variables, not hardcoded passwords
security.network_access: Users must have network access to SQL Server from their machine

server_not_loading: Check VS Code Output panel → MCP Servers
Verify npx is installed (comes with Node.js)
Restart VS Code after config changes
connection_failed: Verify SQL Server hostname and port
skill_works_without_mcp: Email processing does not require MCP servers
Basic workflow continues without database access
Investigation reports will note: 'Database investigation skipped (MCP not configured)'

example_vs_code_settings.description: Example settings.json with MCP server enabled
